lead_raw_text:
The structure of Ba2Ce4Ti8O24 (reduced formula BaCe2(TiO3)4) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 38 atoms in the unit cell distributed over 9 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Ce centers in octahedral coordination by six O neighbors, while Ba adopts a close-packed-like 12-coordinate arrangement of O neighbors; Ti centers are 5-coordinate to O. Corner-sharing between Ce octahedra and Ti polyhedra is observed, as are face-sharing between Ba and Ce polyhedra, forming a three-dimensional connected network.
